heading: Types of BEX
content: One Quasar App can provide a new-tab page, options page, popup, developer-tools page, or UI injected into a web page. Use routes to select the UI for each extension entry point.

heading: New Tab
content: A new-tab extension replaces the browser's new-tab page. Configure the appropriate manifest override to point to `www/index.html`; clicking the extension icon instead uses the manifest's `action` or `browser_action` configuration.
